mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) of more than 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) contraction signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY < -2% AND HOUST monthly change < -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the unemployment rate above 5% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months signals contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 1% month-over-month indicates a significant labor market deterioration, which depresses consumer demand and corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE monthly change > 0.1% AND PAYEMS monthly change < -1.0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 50% of triggered months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 2% for three consecutive months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, which lowers borrowing costs and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their respective 12-month moving averages signals strengthening aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings and supports higher equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.4% for five consecutive months signals a manufacturing expansion, which raises corporate earnings and supports higher equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change > 0.4% for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.
